title: Rohit Sharma Breaks Internet With Stunning New Look, Sheds 10 Kgs Ahead Of India Comeback | Cricket News - News18
text: India ODI captain Rohit Sharma is sweating it out and how! The veteran batter has been working out in the gym ahead of his much-awaited return to competitive cricket having last played for Mumbai Indians in the IPL 2025. Training under the watchful gaze of close friend and former India assistant coach Abhishek Nayar, Rohit has shed an impressive 10 kgs. Nayar revealed Rohit’s new look on social media, captioning the image “10,000 grams later, we keep pushing". Rohit last featured for India in March this year when he produced a player-of-the-match winning performance with the bat in the final of the Champions Trophy against New Zealand to fire his team to title triumph. Earlier in September, the centrally contracted India cricketers flew to BCCI Center of Excellence (COE) in Bengaluru for a pre-season fitness test. Rohit was among the India stars to check in at the facility and reportedly cleared the drills that included Yo-Yo test, a DXA Scan, which is a simplified method to test bone density. While majority of India cricketers were present at the COE, batting superstar Virat Kohli was exempted as he gave his fitness from London where he now resides with his family. It’s expected that Rohit’s first competitive match will be on October 19 when India face hosts Australia in the first game of a three-match ODI series. However, there were speculations that the 38-year-old, alongside Kohli, could play in the unofficial ODI series for India A against Australia A later this month in Kanpur. However, neither has been named in the squad for the three-match series. Meanwhile, there are reports that the Indian selection committee may end up handing maiden ODI call-up to rising star Abhishek Sharma who has made a stunning start to his T20I career. In the ongoing Asia Cup in Dubai, Abhishek has racked up 248 runs from five innings at a strike-rate of 206.67 while averaging 49.60.
